info.title: ETL-D API
info.description:
Stateless Data Middleware. Designed for AI agents, No-Code automation (n8n, Make, Zapier), and high-performance Python integrations.

**Hybrid Billing Model:** We support both **Prepaid Credits** (Pay-As-You-Go) and **Monthly Subscriptions**.

[![Buy Prepaid Credits](https://img.shields.io/badge/Upgrade-Prepaid%20Credits-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=stripe)](https://buy.stripe.com/7sYeVc45h5T88JWdRW6kg0r) 
  
[![Start Subscription](https://img.shields.io/badge/Upgrade-Monthly%20Subscription-blueviolet?style=for-the-badge&logo=stripe)](https://buy.stripe.com/00wcN48lx95k6BObJO6kg0q)

All enrichment endpoints support a global `context` object for localized parsing.

concept.title: Concept
concept.description: The unstructured expense concept, brand name, or accounting code to translate. USE THIS TOOL when you need to categorize a transaction for accounting (e.g., 'Uber' -> 'travel_ground_misc'). NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT use this tool for purely personal non-business expenses that don't fit into standard corporate categories. DO NOT use for tax-only questions.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Optional list of accounting standard prefixes (e.g., 'es_pgc', 'us_gaap'). If provided, only codes from these standards will be returned. DO NOT use if you need all available mappings.

category.title: Category
category.description: The internal category ID from MASTER_ACCOUNTING_MAP.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: Minimalist dictionary of accounting codes, stripped of descriptive names and keywords.

llm_routed.title: Llm Routed
llm_routed.description: Flag indicating if the match was resolved by the LLM fallback engine.

address_line.title: Address Line
address_line.description: A full, single-line address string to be parsed into structured components (street, city, zip, etc.). USE THIS TOOL for any messy or unstructured location data. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT use for just a city name, just a country name, or a set of coordinates unless they are part of a full address string. It expects a physical mail-like address.
examples: 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA

raw_text.title: Raw Text
raw_text.description: The raw content of the Norma 43 (N43) bank statement file.

webhook_url.title: Webhook Url
webhook_url.description: Optional URL to receive a POST request when the batch is complete. Ideal for n8n/Make.

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: The unique identifier for the asynchronous task.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of the task (e.g., 'accepted', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE').

results.title: Results
results.description: The processed results if the task is complete.

error.title: Error
error.description: Detailed error message if the task failed.

raw_data.title: Raw Data
raw_data.description: A single unstructured string containing a person's name, email, phone, and address. USE THIS PIPELINE instead of individual tools when you have a messy contact string (e.g., from a CSV row or a signature) and need to extract all entities at once. It saves tokens and reduces latency compared to calling /name, /contact, and /address separately.
examples: John Doe, CEO, john@example.com, +34666777888, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy

context.description: Optional context for timezone, locale, and transliteration hints.

name.description: Structured name components and gender prediction.

contact.description: Standardized E.164 phone and validated email details.

address.description: Structured address components (street, city, zip, etc.).

concept.title: Concept
concept.description: The transaction concept. USE THIS TOOL for quick, lightweight expense categorization without full accounting codes. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT use for legal or medical diagnosis. It is strictly for general-purpose expense and concept grouping.

plan_type.title: Plan Type
plan_type.description: The type of plan or top-up to purchase.

checkout_url.title: Checkout Url
checkout_url.description: The Stripe Checkout URL for the user to complete the payment.

data.title: Data
data.description: Content to encode (URL, text, or ID).

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: A raw phone number string to validate and format to E.164. USE THIS TOOL to ensure phone numbers are dialable. Supports extensions and messy strings. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT use this tool if you only have a country code without a local number.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: Default ISO country code to use for phone validation if the number is in local format.

email.title: Email
email.description: An email address to validate and analyze for quality (disposable detection, MX record check).

phone_e164.title: Phone E164
phone_e164.description: The phone number in standardized E.164 format.

phone_valid.title: Phone Valid
phone_valid.description: Whether the phone number is mathematically valid.

phone_carrier.title: Phone Carrier
phone_carrier.description: The carrier name associated with the number if detectable.

email_valid.title: Email Valid
email_valid.description: Whether the email format is valid and the domain exists.

email_is_disposable.title: Email Is Disposable
email_is_disposable.description: True if the email belongs to a temporary/disposable provider.

email_normalized.title: Email Normalized
email_normalized.description: The normalized version of the email address.

email_error.title: Email Error
email_error.description: Detailed error message for email validation failure.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA Timezone for relative date resolution.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Language and region hint for parsing rules.

target_currency.title: Target Currency
target_currency.description: ISO 4217 Currency code to force conversion or strict extraction.

transliterate.title: Transliterate
transliterate.description: Convert non-latin scripts (Cyrillic, Hanzi, Arabic) to Latin alphabet.

dynamic_schema.title: Dynamic Schema
dynamic_schema.description: JSON Schema (JSON Object) to enforce on the extraction

date_string.title: Date String
date_string.description: The human-readable or messy date string to parse. Supports relative dates (e.g., 'next Friday'), absolute dates, and mixed formats. USE THIS TOOL whenever you need to normalize a date for database entry. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT use this tool for plain time strings (e.g., '14:00') without any date context. If the input is just a number, it might be a year; specify source_format if known.

source_format.title: Source Format
source_format.description: Expected format of the input date. Use 'auto' for heuristic detection.

date_order.title: Date Order
date_order.description: The expected order of day, month, and year for ambiguous dates (e.g., 01/02/03).

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The desired strftime format for the output string.

formatted.title: Formatted
formatted.description: Human-readable date string formatted according to requested output_format.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The IANA timezone applied to the result (e.g., 'UTC').

original_detected.title: Original Detected
original_detected.description: Natural language description of what the engine detected from the input.

error.title: Error
error.description: Detailed error message if the date parsing failed.

items.title: Items
items.description: A list of strings to identify duplicates within. USE THIS TOOL to clean lists of names, companies, or products.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Similarity threshold (0-100). Higher means stricter matching.

raw_edi.title: Raw Edi
raw_edi.description: Raw ANSI X12 EDI string to parse.

raw_transaction.title: Raw Transaction
raw_transaction.description: A messy transaction string (e.g., 'Uber ride to airport'). USE THIS PIPELINE for end-to-end finance processing. It extracts amounts, categorizes the expense, and maps it to accounting codes in one call.

amount_hint.title: Amount Hint
amount_hint.description: Optional numeric amount if already known, to help the categorizer.

context.description: Optional context for currency and locale hints.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The numeric amount to convert. Must be a float/number.

date.title: Date
date.description: Date of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format. USE THIS TOOL for historical conversions. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT use for real-time crypto rates or future exchange rate predictions. It only supports historical data for fiat currencies.

target_currency.title: Target Currency
target_currency.description: Target ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to 'EUR'.

tax_id.title: Tax Id
tax_id.description: A tax identification number (NIF, CIF, VAT) to validate.

country.title: Country
country.description: The country code for the tax ID validation.

iban.title: Iban
iban.description: An International Bank Account Number (IBAN) to validate.

tax_id_valid.title: Tax Id Valid
tax_id_valid.description: Whether the tax ID is algorithmically valid.

tax_id_reason.title: Tax Id Reason
tax_id_reason.description: Reason for validation result or error message.

tax_id_normalized.title: Tax Id Normalized
tax_id_normalized.description: The tax ID in a standardized format.

iban_valid.title: Iban Valid
iban_valid.description: Whether the IBAN is mathematically correct.

bank_code.title: Bank Code
bank_code.description: Detected bank code from the IBAN.

iban_country.title: Iban Country
iban_country.description: Country code extracted from the IBAN.

bic.title: Bic
bic.description: Business Identifier Code (BIC/SWIFT) associated with the IBAN.

iban_normalized.title: Iban Normalized
iban_normalized.description: The IBAN in a standardized format.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: The fully formatted markdown string, with spatial and table structures intact.

value.title: Value
value.description: Query string to find among choices.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: List of valid options to match against.

min_score.title: Min Score
min_score.description: Minimum similarity score to consider a match reliable.

amount_string.title: Amount String
amount_string.description: A messy string containing a monetary amount, currency symbols, and text noise. USE THIS TOOL to extract precise 'float' values and currency codes from unstructured text. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT attempt to parse currency symbols or decimal marks manually; this tool handles all global symbols. DO NOT use this tool for non-monetary numbers like IDs or phone numbers.

decimal_mark.title: Decimal Mark
decimal_mark.description: Force a specific decimal separator character ('.' or ','). Auto-detected if null.

float_value.title: Float Value
float_value.description: The purified numeric amount as a floating point number.

clean_string.title: Clean String
clean_string.description: A cleaned version of the input string with only relevant monetary data.

conversion_required.title: Conversion Required
conversion_required.description: True if target_currency differs from detected_currency.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message if monetary extraction failed.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: The full person name string to deconstruct into structured JSON (first, last, title, gender). USE THIS TOOL when you have a single 'Name' field and need it split for CRM or personalization. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT use for company names, brand names, or purely descriptive text. It is optimized for human individual names only.

middle.title: Middle
middle.description: The person's middle name or initial.

last.title: Last
last.description: The person's surname or family name.

gender.title: Gender
gender.description: Predicted gender (male, female, unknown) based on linguistic patterns.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The degree of certainty for the gender prediction.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password string to evaluate for strength and breach risk.

user_inputs.title: User Inputs
user_inputs.description: Optional list of user-related strings (email, name) to check against.

poll_id.title: Poll Id
poll_id.description: The unique ID to poll for the API key status.

checkout_url.title: Checkout Url
checkout_url.description: The Stripe Checkout URL for the agent to purchase credits.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status of the provisioning (pending or ready).

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: The generated API key, only if status is ready.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to analyze. USE THIS TOOL to gauge user feedback or emotional tone.

raw_string.title: Raw String
raw_string.description: A messy contact string (e.g., 'John Doe - john@example.com'). USE THIS TOOL to extract structured components from a single line of contact info. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT: DO NOT use this tool for full paragraphs or multiple contacts at once. It expects ONE contact per call.

text.title: Text
text.description: Raw text, CSV, or PDF contents containing trade history from a broker.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Stock or asset ticker (e.g. AAPL, NVDA)

action.description: Trade action: BUY, SELL, DIV, or TRANSFER

fees.title: Fees
fees.description: Total commissions or fees associated with the trade, default to 0.0 if none

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to translate. USE THIS TOOL for universal translation. Supports automatic source language detection.

target_lang.title: Target Lang
target_lang.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the target language (e.g., 'es').

translated_text.title: Translated Text
translated_text.description: The translated version of the input text.

ua_string.title: Ua String
ua_string.description: The raw User-Agent string. If omitted, uses the requester's UA.

input_string.title: Input String
input_string.description: Value and unit to convert (e.g., '150 miles'). USE THIS TOOL for automated unit normalization.

credits_remaining.title: Credits Remaining
credits_remaining.description: The number of credits left on the current API key.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status of the key (active or exhausted).

base_product.title: Base Product
base_product.description: Base product data common to all variants.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Map of variant names to option lists. USE THIS TOOL to generate all possible SKU combinations.

url.title: Url
url.description: Full URL to fetch metadata from. USE THIS TOOL to get page titles and social preview images.

xml_string.title: Xml String
xml_string.description: The raw XML content to flatten into Key-Value pairs.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-KEY
ApiKeyAuth.description: Enter your API key in the X-API-KEY header
